title: 第9章 五家担保联名惠民贴第10章 扭亏为盈调配秘方

同时，潘安继续开口：“但若是被某家检查出哪些药材质量有问题，我潘家指定让各位吃不了兜着走！”
此言一出，又让其他想要浑水摸鱼的山农望而却步。
毕竟清平县内的大家族，两只手就数得过来。
潘家更是平日里收购药材的大户。
一些原本与回春堂，百草轩等药铺有口头约定的山民，露出意动之色，也纷纷涌向潘安。
“保安堂这是要赶尽杀绝啊！”
一个穿着半旧绸衫，身材微胖的中年人，脸色难看的开口。
他是回春堂的掌柜李文，如今正站在林青身边，看着潘安那边的动静，脸色铁青，拳头紧握。
他是林青父亲的好友，以往没少照顾济世堂。
“李叔。”林青低声打了个招呼。
李文叹了口气：“林青啊，你也看到了，潘家仗着内城的财势，这是要垄断外城的药材来源，抬高我们的进货成本，要逼死我们这些小铺子啊。”
林青目光平静，看着潘安那跋扈的身影，低声道：“李叔，保安堂价格压得低，我们斗不过。”
“但他们抬高收购价，也是一把双刃剑。”
“山药集药材量不小，他潘家再有钱，也不可能一口全吃下，总有漏网之鱼。”
“只是长此以往，我等确实难以为继。”
林青目光扫视四周，声音压得更低：“李叔，我们外城几家药铺，难道就只能坐以待毙，等着被潘家一个个吞掉吗？”
李文闻言，眼中闪过一丝精光，看向林青：“贤侄，你的意思是？”
“保安堂本来就是内城大铺，售卖药品价格高昂，如今来到外城，根基不深，全靠价格打压。”
“我们几家在外城经营多年，各有口碑和固定的主顾。若我们几家能联合起来，共享资源……”

林青将自己的想法，低声向李文合盘托出。
李文听着，眼睛越来越亮，脸上的阴郁渐渐被振奋所取代。
他猛地一拍大腿：“好，好个联名惠民贴，共享药剂，互保质量，此法甚妙！”
“如此一来，我们不必与他拼价格，而是比拼药材质量和药剂功效，这正是我们的长处。”
“贤侄，你真是有你父之风，更有青出于蓝之势啊！”
李文不再犹豫：“我这就回城，联络百草轩的张胖子，仁心堂的赵先生，还有保和堂的孙老抠。”
“我倒要看看，他潘家能不能一口把我们五家都吞了！”
……
……
当日下午，回春堂的后院厢房内，门窗紧闭。
除了林青和李文，另外三位药铺当家也悉数到场。
百草轩的张当家，身材肥胖，一脸精明。
仁心堂的赵先生，留着山羊胡，面容清瘦。
保和堂的孙当家，则干瘦矮小，眼神里透着谨慎。
李文作为发起人。
将林青提出的联名惠民贴计划，详细对其他人说了一遍。
“诸位，潘家保安堂狼子野心，昭然若揭。今日他们能抬高市价垄断药材，明日就能压价倾销，挤垮我们。”
“若我等再不联合，迟早被其各个击破，祖辈基业毁于一旦！”李文语气激昂。
张当家胖脸上肥肉抖动，瓮声瓮气道：“李掌柜说的在理，他潘家内城的铺子赚得盆满钵满，还想把爪子伸到外城来断我们活路，忒不地道。联合一事，我同意！”
赵先生捋着胡须，沉吟道：“联合固然是好，但这共享药剂处方，各家皆有安身立命的独门秘方，岂能轻易示人？”

“若无真材实料，空有联名，也难以取信于民啊。”
孙当家也连连点头：“是啊，秘方乃立铺之本，岂可轻授？”
场面一时陷入僵局。

At the same time, Pan An continued to speak: "But if any medicinal materials are found to have quality problems by a certain company, my Pan family will make sure that you can't eat them and walk around!"
As soon as this statement came out, other mountain farmers who wanted to fish in troubled waters were discouraged.
After all, the big families in Qingping County can be counted on two hands.
The Pan family is a big buyer of medicinal materials on weekdays.
Some mountain people who had verbal agreements with Huichun Hall, Baicaoxuan and other drug stores showed signs of excitement and also flocked to Pan An.
"The Security Hall is going to kill them all!"
A slightly fat middle-aged man wearing a semi-old silk shirt spoke with an ugly expression.
He is Li Wen, the shopkeeper of Huichun Hall. He is standing next to Lin Qing, looking at Pan An's movement, his face is livid and his fists are clenched.
He is a good friend of Lin Qing's father and has taken care of Ji Shitang a lot in the past.
"Uncle Li." Lin Qing greeted in a low voice.
Li Wen sighed: "Lin Qing, you have also seen that the Pan family relies on the wealth in the inner city to monopolize the source of medicinal materials in the outer city, raise our purchasing costs, and drive small shops like us to death."
Lin Qing's eyes were calm, looking at Pan An's domineering figure, and whispered: "Uncle Li, the price of Security Hall is too low, we can't compete."
"But the fact that they raised the purchase price is also a double-edged sword."
"The yam collection contains a lot of medicinal materials. No matter how rich the Pan family is, they can't eat them all in one bite. There will always be fish that slip through the net."
"It's just that if this continues, it will be really difficult for us to continue."
Lin Qing glanced around and lowered her voice: "Uncle Li, can we have several drug stores in the outer city just sit back and wait for death, waiting to be swallowed up one by one by the Pan family?"
When Li Wen heard this, a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes, and he looked at Lin Qing: "My dear nephew, what do you mean?"
"Baoan Tang was originally a big shop in the inner city, selling medicines at high prices. Now it has come to the outer city, but its foundation is not deep and it relies entirely on price suppression."
"We have been operating in outer cities for many years, and each has a good reputation and regular customers. If we can join forces and share resources..."
Lin Qing told Li Wenhe his thoughts in a low voice.
As Li Wen listened, his eyes became brighter and brighter, and the gloom on his face was gradually replaced by excitement.
He slapped his thigh suddenly: "Okay, what a joint post to benefit the people, share the medicine, and guarantee the quality of each other. This is a wonderful method!"
"In this way, we don't have to compete with him on price, but on the quality of medicinal materials and potency. This is our strength."
"My dear nephew, you really have the style of your father, and you are even more capable of surpassing others!"
Li Wen no longer hesitated: "I will return to the city right away and contact Fatty Zhang from Baicao Xuan, Mr. Zhao from Renxin Hall, and Sun Laojie from Baohe Hall."
"I want to see if the Pan family can swallow up all five of our families in one go!"
…
…
That afternoon, in the backyard wing of Huichun Hall, the doors and windows were closed.
In addition to Lin Qing and Li Wen, the other three drug store owners were also present.
Zhang, the boss of Baicaoxuan, is fat and has a shrewd look on his face.
Mr. Zhao from Renxintang has a goatee and a thin face.
Boss Sun of Baohe Hall is thin and short, with cautious eyes.
Li Wen serves as the initiator.
Lin Qing's joint plan to benefit the people was explained to others in detail.
"Everyone, the ambition of the Pan family's security hall is obvious. Today they can raise the market price to monopolize medicinal materials, and tomorrow they can lower the price and squeeze us out."
"If we don't unite, we will be defeated by them sooner or later, and the foundation of our ancestors will be destroyed!" Li Wen said in an excited tone.
The fat on Mr. Zhang's fat face trembled, and he said in a loud voice: "Shopkeeper Li is right. His Pan family's shop in the inner city has made a lot of money, and he wants to extend his claws to the outer city to cut off our livelihood. It is unreasonable. I agree with the alliance!"
Mr. Zhao stroked his beard and said thoughtfully: "It is good to unite, but we share the medicine prescription. Each family has its own secret recipe for survival. How can we easily reveal it to others?""If there is no real material and only a joint name, it will be difficult to win the trust of the people."
Master Sun also nodded repeatedly: "Yes, the secret recipe is the basis of establishing a shop, how can we teach it lightly?"
The scene reached a deadlock for a while.
